name: Mounted off: Will Unmount; Checked keeps its value; a click finds nothing; Check still flips (the node, not the page); a Focus is Unchanged; Mounted on: Did Mount, Checked as left

because: utils.ts :82-89 touches only `enabled`; the press is not released by disabling; the click's mouseup releases (utils.ts :265-269)

name: focused, then Mounted off and on: the leaving takes the keyboard and Focused with it — Will Unmount, Focused false and Blurred (D30); Did Mount; a Focus action puts the keyboard on the element that came back and fires Focused; a Tab away then fires Blurred
because: P109 ISL-031 (P107-D30, ruled "Reset and announce"): the browser fires no blur for an element it removes, so the node resets its states as the element leaves (utils.ts `_leftPage`, called from react-component-node.ts `componentWillUnmount`)

name: a person acts on a painted page: Enabled and Mounted both written and an act in the same frame — off together (no element; a Focus after it Unchanged), on together (Did Mount, an enabled element) — every act, both ways
because: the paint inside the act commits the remount and the enabled attribute at once; a Focus and a Blur after it read what was painted

name: disabled and unmounted in one frame, then enabled and remounted in one frame, then a quiet frame: Did Mount once, Enabled true, and nothing more
because: the frame's end paints the remount and the attribute together (react-component-node.ts :1675-1689); the next frame paints nothing

name: a person acts on a painted page: Enabled off with Mounted on (a disabled element arrives: Did Mount, the act takes nothing, a Focus after it Done and nothing focused), then Enabled on with Mounted off (the element leaves) — every act, both ways
because: the paint inside the act commits a remount and the attribute at once; the crossed pairs reach the branches the matched pairs cannot (a release or press on a remounted but disabled element)

name: placed disabled, Mounted off then on with a press in the same frame: Did Mount and nothing else (a disabled element takes no press); a Focus after it Done and nothing focused; the same with a release
because: the paint inside the act commits the remount; the element arrives disabled, so the press and the release meet nothing (React drops them; the browser dispatches none)

name: focused, then Enable Label turned on and a press in the same frame: the box keeps the keyboard — the press fires Pointer Down with Pressed and no Focused; turned off again, a Tab onto it finds the keyboard there already — the runtime rebuilds the input and the keyboard leaves with the old one, silently (the press fires Focused again: was row C80, fixed in P109 ISL-031)
because: ruled 2026-10-05 (C80, all three controls): showing or hiding the label does not touch the box; Checkbox.tsx :167-210 the tree differs with a label, so React makes the input anew (was row C80, fixed in P109 ISL-031)

because: the act paints the page first — the remount commits (didMount) and then the Tab meets the new input; a disabled one takes nothing, but it IS on the page (focus-tracker.ts :61)

name: a press held across a frame, then the release and a Blur action in the same frame: Pointer Up, then Blurred — the keyboard the press gave is still there to take away

name: focused, then the pointer onto the box and a Blur action in the same frame: Hover Start, then Blurred — a hover alone moves no keyboard
because: utils.ts :216-234 the hover; :356-364 the Blur action meets the focused input

name: a click, an Uncheck and a click in one frame: the box ends ticked, Changed twice — the second click meets a box the Uncheck untick-ed

name: hidden, holding the keyboard: every pointer act meets nothing and takes nothing away — the Blur action after each finds the keyboard on the box (Blurred)
because: the browser hit-tests past a hidden element; nothing takes the keyboard off one that has it (no focus fixup); `blur()` works on a hidden element

name: hidden and off the page: Mounted on and an act in the same frame — the act's paint puts the hidden box back (Did Mount) and the act meets nothing (a hidden element is under no pointer and takes no keyboard); a Focus action after it finds the box on the page (Done, takes nothing) — every act
because: NSP-016 s43's hit test with s37's paint-before-the-act: the 10,000 runs (s45, seed 20731) left the act's remount branch alive (a swap with the branch that mounts nothing) — only a read of the page between the act and the frame's end tells them apart

name: hidden, holding the keyboard, Enable Label changed with every pointer act: the act meets nothing and the keyboard stays — the Blur action after each finds it on the box (Blurred); shown again, the box takes the keyboard (the Radio Button's scenario)
because: P109 ISL-031 (C80, C66): the label's wrapper and the input's both stay on the page, and the node writes its root styles straight onto whichever is the root (react-component-node.ts setStyle) — a Visible written while one was the root must not stay on it once the other is (noodl-root-ref.ts clearedRootStyles)

name: focused and under the pointer, then Mounted off, an act and a Focus action in one frame: the act's paint takes the element off the page, and Focused and Hover with it — Will Unmount, Blurred and Hover End (D30) — so the act finds nothing and the Focus is Unchanged; Mounted on: Did Mount; every act
because: P109 ISL-031 (P107-D30): the act paints first (`onPainted`), and the paint that unmounts the element resets the states it held; a Focus action after it in the frame reads the page the act left. The s27 mutant run left a Text Input release on a leaving field ungraded (the frame's end does the same leave, so only a reader between the two can tell them apart)

name: the remount grid: focused, under the pointer, or both; then Mounted off, each act, and Mounted on again in one frame — the act's paint takes the element off the page first (Will Unmount, and Focused / Hover false with Blurred / Hover End for what it held) and the frame's end puts it back: Did Mount
because: utils.ts `_leftPage` from react-component-node.ts `componentWillUnmount` (D30), then `componentDidMount`; the act paints the page before it lands, so the leaving is AT the act — with Mounted written back on later in the same frame, a paint deferred to the frame's end would find the element still there and nothing would leave (P107 s80: seed-only mutant kills on several acts)
